title: P9 report and check labels described a test more narrowly or a count more strongly than the code did
what_went_wrong: A22's check label and R5 §20 say 'a billing row changed'; the suite's UPDATE changes all 17 billing rows of the visit (+Rp 17 in total).
R5 §20 reports '14 verified' restores 'outside the four deliberate fault checks'; the count (RV_ALL) is taken over all transcripts, including the excluded ones.
_finalize() still writes 'FAILED batches (restored from stage backup)' for FAILED batches whose restore was refused or unverified; P9-A1 fixed only the stdout line.
root_cause: Report sentences were written from the intent of each check and from a res line's label, not re-derived from the SQL and grep that produced the numbers.
detection: Astra v9 (gpt-6-astra run 4898353); each item re-verified against the source by the orchestrator on 2026-10-18.

correction.planned: P10: correct the A22 label and R5 §20 wording (strike-through, not deletion); count verification markers outside the excluded logs separately; make the _finalize artifact line conditional on the batch's actual restore result.
correction.done: P10 (2026-10-18): A22 label states all N billing rows (17); R5 §20 struck through and corrected; A11 counts verification markers outside the excluded logs (run 2: 16 of 16, i.e. the excluded logs hold none); _finalize writes each FAILED batch's actual restore state.

rule: Every number or behaviour stated in a report section is re-derived from the exact command that produced it, at the moment of writing.
